name: Neural Transient Field (NeTF)
definition: NeTF is a neural modeling framework for Non-Line-of-Sight (NLOS) imaging that recovers the 5D transient function in both spatial location and direction, implicitly represented by a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP).
summary: Neural Transient Field is a neural framework for Non-Line-of-Sight imaging that parametrizes data on spherical wavefronts using MCMC to handle sparse sampling, unlike ray-based NeRF.
